frequency_question: What proportion of threatened indefinite strikes by major sector-wide labor coalitions actually commence within the stated window rather than being deferred or settled?
membership_rule: Includes formally announced multi-union federation indefinite strike threats in banking, transport, or public utilities where a specific deadline within 35 days is set. Excludes wildcat strikes, single-union localized actions, and actions without a hard deadline.
window: 35-day period preceding or at the strike deadline

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association / UFBU call 2022
Central Trade Unions general strike notice 2023
All India Bank Officers Confederation action 2020
National Confederation of Bank Employees notice 2019

coverage_note: 8 named; representative of major sector union federation strike call outcomes in the jurisdiction over a multi-year baseline.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller regional uncoordinated actions; focuses strictly on national federation federation-level threats.
validity_reason: Labor dispute dynamics and conciliation structures change slowly over legislative and economic cycles.
